english_meaning: A piece of land almost surrounded by water, connected to mainland on one side.
gujarati_meaning: ત્રણ બાજુ પાણીથી ઘેરાયેલ અને એક બાજુ ભૂ-ભાગ સાથે જોડાયેલ જમીન-ટૂકડો.
usage_note: India is a peninsula; Gujarat has the Kathiawar (Saurashtra) peninsula.
examples: The Arabian Peninsula is the world's largest peninsula.
Kerala lies on the southern tip of the Indian Peninsula.
The Saurashtra peninsula juts into the Arabian Sea.
The peninsula was connected to the mainland by a narrow strip of land.

english_meaning: A flat area of high ground; an elevated tableland.
gujarati_meaning: ઊંચાઈ પર આવેલ સપાટ ભૂ-પ્રદેશ — ઉચ્ચ-ભૂમિ.
usage_note: The Deccan Plateau covers much of peninsular India.
memory_tip: 'Plateau' = 'plate' (flat plate) + 'au' → flat like a plate on high ground.
examples: The Deccan Plateau covers most of southern India.
The Tibetan Plateau is the highest in the world.
The plateau offered a panoramic view of the surrounding plains.
Plateau regions often have cooler temperatures than surrounding areas.

english_meaning: A narrow valley between hills or mountains, usually with a river flowing through it.
gujarati_meaning: ડુંગરો વચ્ચે ઊંડી અને સાંકડી ખીણ — નીચે નદી વહે.
usage_note: Formed by river erosion over millions of years; different from a canyon in scale.
examples: The river carved a spectacular gorge through the mountains.
We hiked through the narrow gorge for three hours.
The gorge was home to rare ferns and mosses.
Rafting in the gorge was an unforgettable experience.

english_meaning: The wide part of a river's mouth where it meets the sea, affected by tides.
gujarati_meaning: નદીનું મોં — જ્યાં નદી સમુદ્ર સાથે ભળે — ભરતી-ઓટ અહીં અનુભવાય.
usage_note: Estuaries are highly productive ecosystems supporting diverse species.
memory_tip: 'Estuary' → 'east' → 'river goes east to sea' → estuary = river meets sea.
examples: The Thames Estuary is one of Europe's busiest waterways.
Mangroves often grow in tropical estuaries.
The estuary provides habitat for migratory birds.
Many cities are built near estuaries for trade and transport.

english_meaning: A vast, flat, treeless Arctic region with permanently frozen subsoil.
gujarati_meaning: ધ્રુવ પ્રદેશ નજીક — ઝાડ-ઝાંખરા વિહોણો વિશાળ, સપાટ, સ્થાયી-બરફ ભૂ-ભાગ.
usage_note: The tundra has permafrost below, a short growing season, and low biodiversity.
memory_tip: 'Tundra' → ઠ-ઠ-ઠ = ઠંડા ઠેકાણા (freezing place) → ઠંડો વિસ્તાર.
examples: Reindeer and polar bears live in the tundra.
The Arctic tundra is warming faster than any other biome.
Low shrubs and mosses are typical tundra vegetation.
The tundra seems barren but supports a unique ecosystem.

english_meaning: A slowly moving mass of ice formed by accumulated snow over many years.
gujarati_meaning: ઘણા વર્ષો સુધી જામેલ હિમ — ધીમે ધીમે ખસતો વિશાળ બરફ-ભૂ.
usage_note: Glaciers are retreating worldwide due to climate change.
memory_tip: 'Glaci-' = glassy ice → glacier = કાચ જેવો વિશાળ બરફ-ભૂ.
examples: The Gangotri glacier is the source of the Ganges river.
Glaciers around the world are melting at alarming rates.
A glacial valley has a distinctive U-shaped profile.
Scientists drill ice cores from glaciers to study past climates.

english_meaning: A stretch of shallow seawater separated from the sea by a reef, sandbar, or similar feature.
gujarati_meaning: ખારા/મીઠા છીછરા પાણીનો ઘેરો — ખડક કે રેતી-ટીંબા દ્વારા સમુદ્રથી અલગ.
usage_note: Coral lagoons form inside atolls; coastal lagoons form along shorelines.
memory_tip: 'Lagoon' → 'L' = lake-like → shallow like a lake near the sea.
examples: The turquoise lagoon was perfect for snorkelling.
Chilika Lagoon in Odisha is Asia's largest coastal lagoon.
The coral reef protected the lagoon from ocean waves.
Flamingos flocked to the shallow salt lagoon.

english_meaning: A grassy plain in tropical or subtropical regions, with few trees.
gujarati_meaning: ઉષ્ણ-ઉષ્ણકટિબંધ પ્રદેશોમાં ઘાસ-ઢંકાયેલ વિશાળ મેદાન — ઝાડ ઓછાં.
usage_note: The African savanna is home to elephants, lions, and wildebeest.
examples: Lions hunt on the African savanna.
The savanna has distinct wet and dry seasons.
Giraffes roam the East African savanna.
Fire is a natural part of the savanna ecosystem.

english_meaning: Land that is saturated with water, either permanently or seasonally, such as marshes and swamps.
gujarati_meaning: કાયમ અથવા ઋતુ-ક્રમ પ્રમાણે પાણી-ભૂ —늪, ભેખડ, ખારો ઝૂ.
usage_note: Wetlands filter water, store carbon, and support rich biodiversity.
examples: Wetlands serve as natural water filters.
The Sundarbans is the world's largest mangrove wetland.
Millions of migratory birds depend on wetlands.
Wetland destruction has led to declining amphibian populations.

english_meaning: A deep open crack in a glacier or snowfield.
gujarati_meaning: ગ્લૅશિયર અથવા બરફ-ભૂ પર ઊઘડેલ ઊંડી ફાટ — ખૂબ જોખમકારક.
usage_note: Crevasses are extremely dangerous for mountaineers and glaciologists.
examples: The mountaineer narrowly avoided falling into a crevasse.
Crevasses form where a glacier moves over uneven terrain.
They used ropes to cross the dangerous crevasse.
Snow bridges over crevasses can collapse without warning.

english_meaning: The flat area beside a river that is covered with water when the river floods.
gujarati_meaning: નદી કિનારે આવેલ સપાટ ભૂ — પૂર વખતે ડૂબી જાય.
usage_note: Floodplains are very fertile due to sediment deposition but are flood-prone.
examples: The Nile floodplain is one of the most fertile in the world.
Building on floodplains increases the risk of flood damage.
The floodplain was covered with rich alluvial soil.
Communities on floodplains must have effective early warning systems.

english_meaning: A group or chain of islands scattered in a large body of water.
usage_note: Indonesia is the world's largest archipelago with over 17,000 islands.
memory_tip: 'Archi' = chief + 'pelago' = sea → chief sea = sea full of islands.
examples: Indonesia is the world's largest archipelago.
The Lakshadweep archipelago lies in the Arabian Sea.
The archipelago offered stunning diving spots.
Sea level rise threatens many low-lying archipelagos.

english_meaning: A deep gorge, typically with a river flowing through it, often in an arid region.
gujarati_meaning: ઊંડી, ઢોળાવ-ભરી ખીણ — ખૂ-ભ (dry) પ્રદેશમાં — નીચે નદી.
usage_note: The Grand Canyon in Arizona is the most famous canyon in the world.
memory_tip: 'Canyon' → 'can' = ઠ-ઠ → 'can you see the bottom?' → ઊંડી ખીણ.
examples: The Grand Canyon was carved by the Colorado River.
The canyon walls displayed millions of years of geological history.
Hiking into the canyon takes several hours.
Eagles nest on the sheer walls of the canyon.

english_meaning: A long, narrow, deep inlet of the sea between steep cliffs, formed by glacial erosion.
gujarati_meaning: ઊભા-ઢોળ ખડકો વચ્ચે ઊંડી, સાંકડી, લાંબી ખાડી — ગ્લૅશિયર ઘસારાથી બની.
usage_note: Norway is famous for its spectacular fjords; they are UNESCO-listed.
memory_tip: 'Fjord' → 'F' = ફ = ફાટ (split) → ખડક ફાટ = ઊંડી ખાડી.
examples: Norway's fjords attract millions of tourists every year.
The Sognefjord is the longest fjord in the world.
Cruise ships navigate slowly through the deep fjords.
The fjord was surrounded by snow-capped mountains.

english_meaning: A ridge of rock in the sea formed by the growth of coral, supporting diverse marine life.
gujarati_meaning: સમુદ્રમાં પ્રવાળ (coral) ઉગ્યો અને ખડક-ટ્ટ જેવી રચના — ઘણા દરિયાઈ જીવ-જંતુઓ ત્યાં રહે.
usage_note: Coral reefs cover less than 1% of the ocean floor but support 25% of marine species.
examples: The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system.
Coral reefs are dying due to ocean warming and acidification.
Divers explore the coral reef for its brilliant colours.
Coral reefs protect coastlines from storm waves.

english_meaning: A landform created by sediment deposited where a river meets a body of water, often fan-shaped.
gujarati_meaning: નદી જ્યાં સમુદ્ર/સરોવરને મળે ત્યાં જામેલ કાંપ-માટી — ત્રિકોણ આકારની ભૂ-રચના.
usage_note: The Sundarbans delta (Ganges-Brahmaputra) is the world's largest river delta.
memory_tip: Delta = ∆ (ત્રિકોણ) → triangle shape where river meets sea.
examples: The Nile Delta is one of the most fertile farming regions.
The Sundarbans mangrove forest grows in the Ganges Delta.
The city of New Orleans is built on the Mississippi Delta.
River deltas are rich in biodiversity and agriculture.
